044    /**
045     * MSR and ASR use segment data for segment colors
046     * Assumes tg.H has been revised for clipping
047     * @param tg
048     * @param shapes 
049     */
050    private static void getMSRShapes(TGLight tg,
051            ArrayList<Shape2>shapes)
052    {
053        try
054        {
055            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
056            if(linetype != TacticalLines.MSR && linetype != TacticalLines.ASR && linetype != TacticalLines.TRAFFIC_ROUTE)
057                return;
058
059            HashMap<Integer,Color> hmap= clsUtility.getMSRSegmentColors(tg);
060            Shape2 shape=null;
061            
062            BasicStroke stroke=clsUtility.getLineStroke(tg.get_LineThickness(),tg.get_LineStyle(),tg.get_lineCap(),BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND);
063            
064            int j=0,n=tg.Pixels.size();
065            Color color=null;
066            Shape2 segShape=null;
067            shape=new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
068            shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
069            shape.setStroke(stroke);
070            
071            //if colors are not set then use one shape
072            //assumes colors may be set if string is comma delimited
073//            String strH=tg.get_H();
074//            if(strH != null && !strH.isEmpty())
075//            {               
076//                String[] strs=strH.split(",");
077//                if(strs.length<2)
078//                {
079//                    shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
080//                    //n=tg.Pixels.size();
081//                    //for(j=1;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
082//                    for(j=1;j<n;j++)
083//                    {
084//                        shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
085//                    }
086//                    shapes.add(shape);
087//                    return;
088//                }
089//            }
090                        
091            //if the hashmap contains the segment then use the color corresponding to the segment
092            //in the hashtable to create a one segment shape to add to the shape array.
093            //else sdd the segment to the original shape
094            Color lastColor=null;   //diagnostic
095            double dist=0,dist2=0;
096            POINT2 pt0=null,pt1=null;
097            POINT2 lastPt=null;
098            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size()-1;j++)
099            for(j=0;j<n-1;j++)
100            {
101                pt0=tg.Pixels.get(j);
102                pt1=tg.Pixels.get(j+1);
103                if(hmap !=null && hmap.containsKey(j))
104                {
105                    color=(Color)hmap.get(j);
106                    if(color != lastColor)
107                    {
108                        if(segShape != null)
109                            shapes.add(segShape);                    
110                        
111                        segShape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);                    
112                        segShape.setLineColor(color);
113                        segShape.set_Style(tg.get_LineStyle());
114                        segShape.setStroke(stroke);
115                    }
116                    segShape.moveTo(pt0);
117                    segShape.lineTo(pt1);                    
118                    lastColor=new Color(Integer.toHexString(color.toARGB()));
119               }                                    
120                else
121                {
122                    if(hmap !=null && hmap.containsKey(j+1))
123                    {
124                        shape.moveTo(pt0);
125                        shape.lineTo(pt1);
126                        lastPt=new POINT2(pt1);
127                    }
128                    else if(hmap !=null && hmap.containsKey(j-1))
129                    {
130                        shape.moveTo(pt0);
131                        shape.lineTo(pt1);                        
132                        lastPt=new POINT2(pt1);
133                    }
134                    else if(j==tg.Pixels.size()-2)
135                    {
136                        shape.moveTo(pt0);
137                        shape.lineTo(pt1);                                                
138                    }
139                    else
140                    {
141                        if(lastPt==null)
142                        {
143                            lastPt=new POINT2(pt0);
144                            shape.moveTo(lastPt);
145                            //shape.lineTo(lastPt);
146                        }                        
147                        dist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
148                        if(dist>10)
149                        {
150                            //shape.moveTo(pt0);
151                            shape.lineTo(pt1);                                                
152                            lastPt=new POINT2(pt1);                            
153                        }
154                        else
155                        {
156                            dist2=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(lastPt, pt1);
157                            if(dist2>10)
158                            {
159                                //shape.moveTo(pt0);
160                                shape.lineTo(pt1);                                                
161                                lastPt=new POINT2(pt1);                            
162                            }                            
163                        }
164                    }
165                    //shapes.add(shape);
166                }
167            }
168            if(segShape != null)
169                shapes.add(segShape);                    
170            
171            shapes.add(shape);
172        }
173        catch (Exception exc)
174        {
175            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"getMSRShapes",
176                new RendererException("Failed inside getMSRShapes", exc));
177        }
178    }
179    /**
180     * 
181     * @param tg
182     * @param converter client converter
183     * @param isTextFlipped
184     * @return
185     */
186    public static ArrayList<Shape2> GetLineArray(TGLight tg,
187            IPointConversion converter,
188            boolean isTextFlipped,
189            Object clipBounds)
190    {
191        ArrayList<Shape2> shapes=new ArrayList();
192        try
193        {
194            if(tg.Pixels==null || tg.Pixels.isEmpty())
195                return null;            
196            double x=0;
197            double y=0;
198            double width=0;
199            double height=0;
200            Rectangle2D clipBounds2=null;
201
202            Rectangle2D clipRect=null;
203            ArrayList<Point2D>clipArray=null;
204            if(clipBounds != null)
205            {
206                if(clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.Double.class))
207                {            
208                    //clipRect=(Rectangle2D.Double)clipBounds;
209                    clipRect=(Rectangle2D)clipBounds;
210                    x=clipRect.getMinX()-50;
211                    y=clipRect.getMinY()-50;
212                    width=clipRect.getWidth()+100;
213                    height=clipRect.getHeight()+100;
214                    clipBounds2=new Rectangle2D.Double(x,y,width,height);
215                }
216                else if(clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle.class))
217                {
218                    Rectangle rectx=(Rectangle)clipBounds;
219                    clipRect=new Rectangle2D.Double(rectx.x,rectx.y,rectx.width,rectx.height);
220                    x=clipRect.getMinX()-50;
221                    y=clipRect.getMinY()-50;
222                    width=clipRect.getWidth()+100;
223                    height=clipRect.getHeight()+100;
224                    clipBounds2=new Rectangle2D.Double(x,y,width,height);                    
225                }
226                else if(clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ArrayList.class))
227                {
228                    clipArray=(ArrayList<Point2D>)clipBounds;
229                    clipBounds2= armyc2.c5isr.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.getMBR(clipArray);
230                }
231            }
232
233            int lineType = tg.get_LineType();
234            // In some cases render shapes as another line type but return to input line type before adding modifiers
235            final int inputLineType = lineType;
236
237            // Render complex arrows as simple arrow when very small
238            double DPIScaleFactor = RendererSettings.getInstance().getDeviceDPI() / 96.0;
239            if ((lineType == TacticalLines.FOLLA || lineType == TacticalLines.FOLSP || lineType == TacticalLines.CONVOY)
240                    && lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(tg.Pixels.get(0), tg.Pixels.get(1)) <= 30 * DPIScaleFactor) {
241                lineType = TacticalLines.DIRATKSPT;
242                tg.set_LineType(lineType);
243            }
244
245            int minPoints2;
246            MSInfo msInfo = MSLookup.getInstance().getMSLInfo(tg.get_SymbolId());
247            if (msInfo != null) {
248                minPoints2 = msInfo.getMinPointCount();
249            } else {
250                minPoints2 = -1;
251            }
252
253            boolean bolResult = clsUtility.IsChange1Area(lineType);
254            int bolMeTOC= clsMETOC.IsWeather(tg.get_SymbolId());
255            
256            ArrayList<POINT2>pts=new ArrayList();
257            //uncomment one line for usas1314
258            Boolean usas1314=true;
259            int j=0,n=tg.Pixels.size();
260            if (tg.get_LineType() == TacticalLines.SINGLEC) {
261                //reverse single concertina
262                pts=(ArrayList<POINT2>)tg.Pixels.clone();
263                //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
264                for(j=0;j<n;j++)
265                    tg.Pixels.set(j, pts.get(pts.size()-j-1));
266            }
267
268            //set CELineArray.shapes properties
269            BufferedImage bi=new BufferedImage(8,8,BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
270            Graphics2D g2d=bi.createGraphics();
271            g2d.setFont(tg.get_Font());
272
273            if(tg.Pixels.size()<minPoints2)
274            {
275                bolResult=false;
276            }
277
278            if (bolResult)
279            {
280
281                tg.Pixels.clear();
282                bolResult = clsUtilityCPOF.Change1TacticalAreas(tg, lineType, converter, shapes);
283            }
284            else if(bolMeTOC>0)
285            {
286                if(tg.Pixels.size()<2)
287                    return null;
288
289                try
290                {
291                    clsMETOC.GetMeTOCShape(tg, shapes);
292                }
293                catch(Exception exc)
294                {
295                    ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"GetLineArray",
296                        new RendererException("Failed inside GetLineArray", exc));
297                }
298            }
299            else
300            {
301                //this will help with click-drag mode
302                if(tg.Pixels.size()<2)
303                    if(lineType != TacticalLines.BS_CROSS)
304                        return null;
305                
306                if (CELineArray.CIsChannel(lineType) == 0)
307                {
308                    if(lineType==TacticalLines.ASR || lineType==TacticalLines.MSR || lineType==TacticalLines.TRAFFIC_ROUTE)
309                    {
310                        getMSRShapes(tg,shapes);
311                    }
312                    else
313                    {
314                        //if not using line patterns, generate points
315                        if(!(tg.get_UseLinePattern() && LinePattern.supportsLinePattern(tg.get_SymbolId())))
316                            tg.Pixels=arraysupport.GetLineArray2(tg, tg.Pixels,shapes, clipBounds2, converter);
317                        else {
318                            clsChannelUtility.DrawChannelPatterns(tg.get_Pixels(),tg,shapes);
319                        }
320                    }
321                }
322                else //channel type
323                {
324                    //if not using line patterns, generate points
325                    if(!(tg.get_UseLinePattern() && LinePattern.supportsLinePattern(tg.get_SymbolId())))
326                        clsChannelUtility.DrawChannel(tg.Pixels, lineType, tg,shapes, null, clipBounds2, converter);
327                    else {
328                        clsChannelUtility.DrawChannelPatterns(tg.get_Pixels(),tg,shapes);
329                    }
330                }
331            }
332            //set CELineArray.shapes properties
333            if(bolMeTOC<=0)
334            {
335                if(lineType!=TacticalLines.ASR && lineType!=TacticalLines.MSR && lineType!=TacticalLines.TRAFFIC_ROUTE)
336                    clsUtility.SetShapeProperties(tg,shapes,bi);
337            }
338
339            if (lineType != inputLineType) {
340                // lineType was switched temporarily while rendering shapes
341                tg.set_LineType(inputLineType);
342            }
343
344            //at this point tg.Pixels has the points from CELineArray
345            //the following line adds modifiers for those sybmols which require
346            //the calculated points to use for the modifiers.
347            //currentlly only BLOCK, CONTAIN, ESCORT, Infiltraion and Exfiltration use tg.Pixels
348            //for computing the modifiers after the call to GetLineArray
349            //Modifier2.AddModifiers2(tg);//flipped only for 3d for change 1 symbols
350            Modifier2.AddModifiers2(tg, converter);
351
352            //boundary has shapes for line break
353            Modifier2.GetIntegralTextShapes(tg, g2d, shapes);
354
355            bi.flush();
356            g2d.dispose();
357            bi=null;
358            g2d=null;
359        }
360        catch (Exception exc)
361        {
362            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"GetLineArray",
363                new RendererException("Failed inside GetLineArray", exc));
364        }
365        return shapes;
366    }
367    /**
368     * Isolate and others require special handling for the fill shapes.
369     * @param tg 
370     * @param shapes the existing shapes which characterize the graphic
371     */
372    static protected void getAutoshapeFillShape(TGLight tg, ArrayList<Shape2>shapes)
373    {
374        try
375        {            
376            if(shapes==null || shapes.size()==0)
377                return;
378            if(tg.Pixels==null || tg.Pixels.size()==0)
379                return;
380            if(tg.get_FillColor()==null)
381                return;
382            
383            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
384            int j=0;
385            Shape2 shape=new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL);
386            shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
387            shape.setLineColor(null);
388            int t=shapes.size();
389            int n=tg.Pixels.size();
390            switch(linetype)
391            {
392                case TacticalLines.RETAIN:
393                    if(shapes!=null && !shapes.isEmpty())
394                        //for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
395                        for(j=0;j<t;j++)
396                            shapes.get(j).setFillColor(null);
397                    
398                    shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
399                    for(j=1;j<26;j++)                    
400                        shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
401                    
402                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
403                    shapes.add(0,shape);
404                    break;
405                case TacticalLines.SECURE:
406                case TacticalLines.CONTROL:
407                case TacticalLines.LOCATE:
408                case TacticalLines.OCCUPY:
409                    if(shapes!=null && !shapes.isEmpty())
410                        //for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
411                        for(j=0;j<t;j++)
412                            shapes.get(j).setFillColor(null);
413                    
414                    shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
415                    //for(j=1;j<tg.Pixels.size()-3;j++)                    
416                    for(j=1;j<n-3;j++)                    
417                        shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
418                    
419                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
420                    shapes.add(0,shape);
421                    break;
422                case TacticalLines.CONVOY:
423                case TacticalLines.HCONVOY:
424                    if(shapes!=null && !shapes.isEmpty())
425                        //for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
426                        for(j=0;j<t;j++)
427                            shapes.get(j).setFillColor(null);
428                    
429                    shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
430                    //for(j=1;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)                    
431                    for(j=1;j<n;j++)                    
432                        shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
433                    
434                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
435                    shapes.add(0,shape);
436                    break;
437                case TacticalLines.CORDONSEARCH:
438                case TacticalLines.CORDONKNOCK:
439                case TacticalLines.ISOLATE:
440                case TacticalLines.DENY:
441                    //set the fillcolor to null for the existing shapes
442                    //we are going to create a new fill shape
443                    if(shapes!=null && !shapes.isEmpty())
444                        //for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
445                        for(j=0;j<t;j++)
446                            shapes.get(j).setFillColor(null);
447                    
448                    shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
449                    for(j=26;j<47;j++)                    
450                        shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
451                    
452                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(23));
453                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(24));
454                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(25));
455                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
456                    shapes.add(0,shape);
457                    break;
458                default:
459                    return;
460            }
461        }
462        catch (Exception exc)
463        {
464            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"getAutoshapeFillShape",
465                new RendererException("Failed inside getAutoshapeFillShape", exc));
466        }
467    }
